item.title: NEW SCP IDEA: Seeking Greenlights
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: YES.

Page Type: NEW SCP IDEA.

Genre (Optional): N/A

Page Layout (Optional): N/A

Elevator Pitch: While the Site-71 personnel’s worked, an intruder alert went off,
at the lab, a man in black tactical suite appeared suddenly out of nothing fighting an humanoid creature, the man was heard referring the creature as SCP-XXXX & saying " you really need to learn when to stop", then SCP-XXXX gives him a strong punch throws him halfway the lab, realizing that SCP-XXXX still strong, the man hid while telling the researchers “don’t look at his eyes“, seconds later MTF arrived but SCP-XXXX was long gone, so they apprehended the man, many interrogations & interviews logged but basically the result was that the man came from another universe/dimension or as he like to say (Earth-16), and that he is one of SCP-MTF: Alpha 1 as well as claiming that SCP-XXXX is vulnerable to quantum type of weaponry and also that he followed SCP-XXXX to our earth (Earth-1) in order to contain him, further research has been indicated, and the study’s showed a 3496 year old drowning inside a cave in what now known as Dubai, United Arab Emirates describing how SCP-XXXX was last seen in (Earth-1) at least 6000 years ago and disappeared sometime between 4500 and 3496 years ago, that`s until now.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: Since the last encounter with SCP-XXXX,
site-71 investigated hundreds of reports of sudden violent and murder victim’s That's in reference to the soldier statement that SCP-XXXX causes violence and death, but unfortunately that was useless until they had a call from one of MTF: Luta-10 and he in Dubai police department that he had a call from a man chased by a guy with SCP-XXXX description, site-71 tracked the caller into an area with no civilians and found that the caller was possessed by SCP-XXXX so they neutralized the possessed man, SCP-XXXX re-materialized but this time MTF were ready they used special kind of goggles to prevent him from possessing them, MTF team’s started to fight SCP-XXXX and had many casualties before he ran towards heavy populated area, Site-71 evacuated the area, MTF surrounded SCP-XXXX within 900.000 square meter area called “CITY WALK” in Dubai then MTF continued to fight with him, more casualties accorded, backup was called to help with rifles that shoots a quantum bullet that absorbs SCP-XXXX`s energy, Finley SCP-XXXX was weakened & contained in a quantum based container deep underground in site-71.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Further study’s showed that SPC-XXXX has the power to possess humans body,
in such action the possessed humans are considered dead duo to the fact that SCP-XXXX won’t leave the body as long the body survives, SCP-XXXX only re-materializes into his form after the body dies, however researchers discovered ancient texts indicating SCP-XXXX can change his size to at least 18 meters and that he possesses the strength equivalent to 150 men`s [ NOTHING CONFIRMED ].
